name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Composable primary navigation with provider state, collapse modes, and a List Item menu hierarchy.

api.description: Composable primary navigation. SidebarProvider owns open state, height, and collapse defaults. Compose header, scrollable content, and footer with List Item rows.

groups.title: SidebarProvider
groups.description: Layout wrapper and context host. Wrap Sidebar and SidebarInset.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial expanded state when uncontrolled.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled expanded state on desktop.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when desktop open state changes.

props.name: layout
props.description: app uses fixed viewport chrome. frame positions inside a sized host.

props.name: fillHeight
props.description: Stretch to the viewport (app) or host (frame). When false, height hugs content. Ignored when height is set.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height. Sets --df-sidebar-height and wins over fillHeight.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default appearance for nested Sidebar.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Default collapse mode for nested Sidebar.

props.name: edgeCollapse
props.description: Default for nested Sidebar. Double-click the content-facing seam to toggle on desktop. Ignored when collapsible is none or on mobile. Unavailable in frame layout while offcanvas is collapsed.

props.name: edgeBorder
props.description: Default for nested Sidebar. Shows a seam hover accent when edgeCollapse is enabled.

props.name: side
props.description: Default edge for nested Sidebar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for toggles and the mobile panel.

props.name: keyboardShortcut
props.description: When true, mod+b toggles the sidebar.

props.name: width
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width.

props.name: iconWidth
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width-icon. Omit to track paddingInline.

props.name: mobileWidth
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width-mobile.

props.name: padding
props.description: Sets --df-sidebar-padding-block and --df-sidebar-padding-inline to the same length.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-padding-block on the panel.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-padding-inline. Also feeds default --df-sidebar-width-icon unless iconWidth is set.

props.name: radius
props.description: Panel corner radius. Sets --df-sidebar-radius and --df-sidebar-radius-floating.

props.name: sectionRadius
props.description: Default radius for header, footer section, footer, and groups.

props.name: itemRadius
props.description: Radius for menu buttons and group labels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap inside header and footer stacks.

props.name: groupGap
props.description: Default gap inside SidebarGroup. Override per group with SidebarGroup gap.

props.name: groupPadding
props.description: Default padding on all SidebarGroup axes.

props.name: groupPaddingBlock
props.description: Default SidebarGroup block padding.

props.name: groupPaddingInline
props.description: Default SidebarGroup inline padding.

props.name: groupPaddingBlockStart
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-block-start.

props.name: groupPaddingBlockEnd
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-block-end.

props.name: groupPaddingInlineStart
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-inline-start.

props.name: groupPaddingInlineEnd
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-inline-end.

props.name: menuItemNestPaddingBottom
props.description: Default bottom space for a last-in-menu item that owns SidebarMenuSub. Pass false for 0. Forced to 0 while icon-collapsed. Override per row with nestPaddingBottom.

props.name: children
props.description: Typically Sidebar and SidebarInset.

groups.title: Sidebar
groups.description: Panel shell. Compose SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, optional SidebarFooterSection, and optional SidebarFooter. On mobile, children render in an overlay panel.

props.name: side
props.description: Overrides the provider side.

props.name: variant
props.description: docked is flush with an inner-edge border. floating insets the rail over the workspace fill. inset elevates SidebarInset.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: offcanvas slides away. icon collapses to icon width. none stays expanded.

props.name: edgeCollapse
props.description: Overrides the provider. Enables the seam double-click toggle on desktop. Unavailable in frame layout while offcanvas is collapsed; use SidebarTrigger to reopen.

props.name: edgeBorder
props.description: Overrides the provider. Shows the seam hover accent when edgeCollapse is enabled.

props.name: children
props.description: Header, Content, Footer, Group, and Menu parts.

groups.title: SidebarInset
groups.description: Main workspace region beside the sidebar peer.

props.name: children
props.description: Page or tool content.

groups.title: SidebarTrigger
groups.description: Ghost icon button that calls toggleSidebar.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional custom icon. Defaults to PanelLeft.

groups.title: SidebarHeader
groups.description: Sticky top region. For icon collapse, keep one leading control beside optional data-df="sidebar-brand-copy".

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius.

props.name: children
props.description: Brand row, SidebarTrigger, and SidebarInput.

groups.title: SidebarContent
groups.description: Scrollable middle region with a kit ScrollArea. Place SidebarGroup parts here. Do not nest another ScrollArea.

props.name: separators
props.description: When true, insert a SidebarSeparator between each child. Fragments and arrays flatten first. Skips neighbors that are already separators. Does not affect footer parts.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: thumb uses --df-sidebar-scrollbar-track-inset. edge uses --df-sidebar-scrollbar-edge-inset (default 0, flush).

props.name: thumbShape
props.description: ScrollArea thumb corner shape.

props.name: orientation
props.description: ScrollArea axes.

props.name: side
props.description: ScrollArea scrollbar edge. Defaults to the content-facing side of the sidebar.

props.name: visibility
props.description: ScrollArea thumb visibility.

props.name: space
props.description: ScrollArea track inset. Defaults to none. Forced to none while icon-collapsed.

props.name: width
props.description: ScrollArea scrollbar thickness in pixels.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes on the ScrollArea viewport.

props.name: children
props.description: Typically SidebarGroup parts.

groups.title: SidebarFooterSection
groups.description: Sticky utility stack after SidebarContent. Pins alone or above SidebarFooter. Use for Settings, Help, and similar rows.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius.

props.name: paddingBlockEnd
props.description: Bottom padding after utility rows. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-gap. Pass false for 0. After FooterSection, panel section-gap to the next Footer or separator collapses so this padding owns that air.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu rows, SidebarSeparator, or custom chrome.

groups.title: SidebarFooter
groups.description: Sticky bottom region after content and FooterSection. Prefer SidebarSeparator, then SidebarProfileMenu for the account switcher.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarSeparator, SidebarProfileMenu, or custom chrome.

groups.title: SidebarInput
groups.description: SearchInput for the header. Default pill variant. Hidden in icon collapse.

props.name: size
props.description: SearchInput size.

props.name: variant
props.description: SearchInput shape.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear control when the field has a value.

props.name: background
props.description: Field fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted). Overrides the pill resting and filled recipes.

groups.title: SidebarSeparator
groups.description: Separator with sidebar chrome. Prefer SidebarContent separators for rules between groups.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the rule.

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true, treated as presentational for assistive tech.

props.name: color
props.description: Rule color. Sets --df-sidebar-separator.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the Separator root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the Separator root.

groups.title: SidebarGroup
groups.description: Nav section with optional label and content. Set collapsible to expand and collapse the body.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Show a chevron on SidebarGroupLabel that toggles SidebarGroupContent.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state when collapsible.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state when collapsible.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open changes while collapsible.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the label, optional separators, and content.

props.name: padding
props.description: Sets all four group padding axes to the same length.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Sets group padding-block-start and padding-block-end.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Sets group padding-inline-start and padding-inline-end.

props.name: paddingBlockStart
props.description: Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-start.

props.name: paddingBlockEnd
props.description: Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-end.

props.name: paddingInlineStart
props.description: Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-start.

props.name: paddingInlineEnd
props.description: Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-end.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarGroupContent, and optional SidebarSeparator.

groups.title: SidebarGroupLabel
groups.description: Section title from Label with as="div". Collapsible groups append a chevron in the trailing slot.

props.name: children
props.description: Group title text.

props.name: leading
props.description: Slot before the title. Prefer FeaturedIcon plain at size sm with glyphShadow off.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Optional trailing meta before the collapsible chevron.

props.name: color
props.description: Title color. Defaults to --df-sidebar-group-label-fg.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Title font family. Sets --df-label-font.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Title font size. Sets --df-label-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Title font weight. Sets --df-label-weight.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a single child. Skips the automatic collapsible chevron.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root.

groups.title: SidebarGroupAction
groups.description: Trailing icon button for SidebarGroupLabel. Collapsible groups render a chevron automatically.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually a single icon.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a single child element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the control.

groups.title: SidebarGroupContent
groups.description: Group body. Collapsible groups animate open and closed and set inert while closed.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep content mounted while closed so height can animate.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually a SidebarMenu.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the content body.

groups.title: SidebarMenu
groups.description: Semantic ul for navigation and utility rows. Use SidebarProfileMenu for the account switcher in SidebarFooter.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarMenuItem rows.

groups.title: SidebarProfileMenu
groups.description: Semantic ul for the account switcher in SidebarFooter. Place SidebarMenuItem rows with a stacked List Item trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarMenuItem rows for the profile trigger.

groups.title: SidebarMenuItem
groups.description: List row wrapper. Place a List Item as the interactive child. Optional SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuBadge, and SidebarMenuAction are siblings.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown when the sidebar is icon-collapsed on desktop.

props.name: nestPaddingBottom
props.description: Bottom space when this item owns a direct SidebarMenuSub and is last in its menu. Pass false to disable. Forced to 0 while icon-collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: List Item row, plus optional SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuBadge, or SidebarMenuAction.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the li.

groups.title: SidebarMenuButton
groups.description: Deprecated compatibility shim over List Item. Prefer List Item inside SidebarMenuItem.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Forwards to List Item asChild.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Maps to List Item selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Maps to List Item size.

props.name: variant
props.description: outline adds a hairline ring via a shim class.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Legacy collapsed tooltip. Prefer tooltip on SidebarMenuItem.

props.name: children
props.description: Leading icon plus label.

groups.title: SidebarMenuAction
groups.description: Absolute action control on a menu item.

props.name: showOnHover
props.description: Hide until the item is hovered or focused.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a single child element.

groups.title: SidebarMenuBadge
groups.description: Trailing count or status badge on a menu item.

props.name: children
props.description: Badge content.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSub
groups.description: Nested menu list with a leading guide border. Hidden in icon mode.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarMenuSubItem rows with List Item children.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSubItem
groups.description: Nested list row. Place a List Item as the interactive child.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually a List Item.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the li.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSubButton
groups.description: Deprecated compatibility shim over List Item for nested rows. Prefer List Item inside SidebarMenuSubItem.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Forwards to List Item asChild.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Maps to List Item selected.

props.name: size
props.description: "sm" maps to List Item xs. "md" maps to List Item md.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested row label or asChild link.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSkeleton
groups.description: Loading placeholder row for menu lists.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Show a leading icon skeleton beside the text bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the skeleton row.

groups.title: useSidebar
groups.description: Context hook. Throws when used outside SidebarProvider.

props.name: state
props.description: Desktop expand state.

props.name: open
props.description: Desktop expanded when true.

props.name: setOpen
props.description: Set desktop open state.

props.name: openMobile
props.description: Mobile overlay open state.

props.name: setOpenMobile
props.description: Set mobile overlay open state.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: True when the mobile breakpoint is active.

props.name: toggleSidebar
props.description: Toggle desktop open or mobile overlay.

props.name: side
props.description: Provider default edge.

props.name: variant
props.description: Provider default appearance.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Provider default collapse mode.

props.name: edgeCollapse
props.description: Provider default for the seam toggle.

props.name: edgeBorder
props.description: Provider default for the seam hover accent.

props.name: layout
props.description: Provider layout mode.

props.name: fillHeight
props.description: Provider fillHeight prop value.

props.name: heightMode
props.description: Resolved height mode from height and fillHeight.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for toggles and the mobile panel.

props.name: hostRef
props.description: Ref to the SidebarProvider host element.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width
props.description: Expanded desktop width.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width-icon
props.description: Icon-collapse width. Defaults to one md menu button plus inline padding.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width-mobile
props.description: Mobile overlay width.

props.name: --df-sidebar-height
props.description: Fixed shell height when SidebarProvider height is set.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding-block
props.description: Block padding on the sidebar panel.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding-inline
props.description: Inline padding on header, footer section, footer, and the content viewport. Feeds default --df-sidebar-width-icon.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding
props.description: Shorthand for panel block padding and section inline padding.

props.name: --df-sidebar-item-padding-inline
props.description: Inline padding inside menu buttons, group labels, and matching header rows.

props.name: --df-sidebar-gap
props.description: Gap inside header and footer stacks.

props.name: --df-sidebar-section-gap
props.description: Gap between panel sections and between sections in SidebarContent.

props.name: --df-sidebar-footer-section-padding-block-end
props.description: Default bottom padding on SidebarFooterSection. Override with paddingBlockEnd.

props.name: --df-sidebar-scrollbar-track-inset
props.description: Content-facing inset for the thumb scrollbar in SidebarContent.

props.name: --df-sidebar-scrollbar-edge-inset
props.description: Content-facing inset for the edge scrollbar in SidebarContent. Default 0 is flush.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-gap
props.description: Gap inside SidebarGroup.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-start
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-block-start.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-end
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-block-end.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-start
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-inline-start.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-end
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-inline-end.

props.name: --df-sidebar-menu-gap
props.description: Gap between menu rows inside SidebarMenu.

props.name: --df-sidebar-menu-item-nest-padding-bottom
props.description: Bottom padding on a last-in-menu SidebarMenuItem that owns a direct SidebarMenuSub.

props.name: --df-sidebar-floating-inset
props.description: Outer inset for floating and inset variants.

props.name: --df-sidebar-bg
props.description: Panel background.

props.name: --df-input-bg
props.description: SidebarInput field fill. Override with SidebarInput background.

props.name: --df-search-input-bg
props.description: SidebarInput pill resting fill.

props.name: --df-search-input-bg-filled
props.description: SidebarInput pill filled fill.

props.name: --df-sidebar-fg
props.description: Panel foreground.

props.name: --df-sidebar-border
props.description: Panel border and edge hover accent.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-duration
props.description: Duration for expand and collapse shell travel.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-ease
props.description: Easing for expand and collapse shell travel.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-duration
props.description: Duration for content fades during icon collapse.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-ease
props.description: Easing for content fades during icon collapse.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-delay-expand
props.description: Delay before content fades in when expanding from icon mode.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-hit-width
props.description: Desktop hit width for the content-facing seam toggle.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-left
props.description: Seam cursor when the available action is toward the left.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-right
props.description: Seam cursor when the available action is toward the right.

props.name: --df-sidebar-z-edge
props.description: Stacking for the content-facing seam hit target.

props.name: --df-sidebar-separator
props.description: SidebarSeparator rule color.

props.name: --df-sidebar-accent
props.description: Hover and active fill.

props.name: --df-sidebar-menu-button-height-md
props.description: Default menu row height.

props.name: --df-sidebar-radius
props.description: Docked panel radius.

props.name: --df-sidebar-radius-floating
props.description: Floating and inset panel radius.

props.name: --df-sidebar-section-radius
props.description: Default radius for header, footer section, footer, and groups.

props.name: --df-sidebar-item-radius
props.description: Radius for menu buttons and group labels.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-label-fg
props.description: Default SidebarGroupLabel title color.

props.name: --df-demo-stage-height
props.description: Shared height for docs workspace stage frames.

props.name: --df-sidebar-mobile-scrim
props.description: Mobile overlay scrim behind the panel.
